comment: Reference detection rule definitions for Elastic Security (Detection Engine). Create equivalent rules in the Kibana UI under Security → Rules. Field names match Honeyshop ECS-ish mapping from Logstash.

rules.name: Honeyshop - High Volume Source IP
rules.description: Single source IP generating high interaction volume against Honeyshop (possible scan/brute force).

rules.name: Honeyshop - Login Attempts
rules.description: Login attempts or concentrated SSH activity against Honeyshop.

rules.name: Honeyshop - Suspicious Payload
rules.description: Common exploit or malware payload patterns in honeypot captures.
rules.query: honeypot.payload: (*wget* or *curl* or *"/bin/bash"* or *"/bin/sh"* or *"nc -e"* or *"python -c"* or *base64* or *"chmod +x"* or *Mirai* or *BusyBox*)

rules.name: Honeyshop - Service Spike
rules.description: Unusual volume against a single honeypot service.
